  • Realizar extrações, verificações, análises e atualizações nas ferramentas e bases de dados utilizadas pela área de gestão dos portfólios de TIC, emitindo reportes periódicos e/ou eventual.
  • Executar controles de auditoria e conformidade nos itens dos portfólios de TIC, incluindo controles relacionados à Lei Sarbanes‑Oxley (SOX).

  • Realizar análise crítica de documentos.
  • Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento sobre evolução/melhorias/ajustes das ferramentas que suportam a gestão dos portfólios de TIC.
  • Configurar consultas e visualizações nas ferramentas de acompanhamento dos portfólios de TIC.
  • Gerar e acompanhar incidentes para tratamento de dúvidas ou erros nas ferramentas que suportam as atividades de gestão dos portfólios de TIC.
  • Assessorar, disseminar e esclarecer dúvidas de empregados do cliente ou prestadores de serviços na compreensão dos processos, metodologias e ferramentas relacionadas à gestão dos portfólios de TIC, assim como nas melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos e gestão de portfólios praticadas pelo mercado e adotadas pelo cliente.
  • Elaborar e enviar comunicados sobre alterações nos processos, metodologias e ferramentas que apoiam a gestão dos portfólios de TIC, desdobrar e informar sobre atividades, normas e diretrizes definidas pela área de gestão dos portfólios de TIC.
  • Diligenciar planos de ações derivados do diagnóstico de maturidade dos processos de gestão de portfólios de TIC (ex: relatórios, OPM3, pesquisas de maturidade, entre outros).
  • Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional.
  • Sugerir novos métodos de trabalho/rotina e encaminhar para análise do gestor responsável.
  • Informar sobre responsabilidades ou andamento das tarefas.
  • Revisar materiais desenvolvidos na execução das atividades da área.
  • Investigar as causas-raízes de desvios identificados.

Requisitos

Graduação de nível superior completo nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (Gestão de TI, Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Infraestrutura de TI, ou equivalente); Telecomunicações; Ciências Econômicas ou Contábeis; Administração de Empresas, Pedagogia ou Negócios ou Engenharia da Produção.

Experiência desejável: 3 anos em atuação como analista de sistemas, gerente de projetos, gestor de portfólio ou cargo correlato a linha de serviço de atuação.

Conhecimento em domínio em Microsoft Office ou equivalente, especialmente em planilhas eletrônicas e no Microsoft Project.

title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
  • Provide real‑time customer experience in a 24/7 operating environment
  • Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to relevant owners and teams, and follow through on resolutions
  • Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results
  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to create narratives outlining weekly findings, variances to goals, and present these findings in a review forum
  • Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, measuring and identifying activities performed
  • Quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data

  • Experience with Excel
  • Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written

Preferred Qualifications

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

Basic Function

Howard University is currently seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Assistant to work on a federally funded research study related to COVID-19. The Research Assistants will be primarily responsible for recruiting potential adult participants at Howard University Hospital in Washington DC and the neighboring communities. Participants to be enrolled for the study are past COVID-19 patients. The study seeks to assess Long COVID prevalence and associated risk factors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Screen electronic medical records to identify eligible study participants, contact potential participants in a timely manner.
  • Obtain informed consent in accordance with research protocols, procedures, and good clinical practice guidelines.
  • Administer survey assessments and enter data in REDCap.
  • Perform and document risk assessments.
  • Attend mandatory study specific trainings and team meetings.
  • Complete and file daily paperwork accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Organize and maintain study participants’ data and extract medical data as needed.
  • Document accurate encounters and shift events, adhere to all study procedures, and communicate daily/weekly updates to study coordinator and recruitment lead.
  • Assist the follow-up team in preparing participants’ scheduling and completing follow-up visits virtually and in person.
  • Other duties deemed necessary to maintain smooth operations of the research program such as biospecimen preparation, packaging and mailing to the biorepository core.

Core Competencies

As a critical component to the success of the study, the primary responsibility of the Research Assistants will be patients’ engagement, community outreach, and participants’ enrollment in the study. Personable, detail-oriented, flexible with scheduling, able to work independently and as part of a team.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Sciences, Public Health or health-related fields.

Previous research experience, clinic/hospital work or volunteer experience, and knowledge of the research process is preferred. This position requires flexibility and availability to adapt to patients’ schedules. Reliable transportation is necessary to complete participants’ interviews at various community locations. Spanish language is a plus.

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de vendas . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa , bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer part de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • atendimento consultivo à cliente;
  • ser guardiã da experiência em loja, propagando a cultura da marca;
  • acompanhar de forma proativa toda a jornada do cliente na loja, desde a entrada até a saída, garantindo uma experiência de compra diferenciada;
  • foco na fidelização e realização do pós-venda (através da ferramenta Dito), mantendo nossas clientes sempre apaixonadas;
  • gerenciar suas próprias vendas e entregas, assegurando a eficiência;
  • impulsionar as vendas digitais, promovendo o código de vendedora e utilizando redes sociais, com foco em criar engajamento e gerar encantamento em cada interação;
  • manter o ambiente da loja organizado, produção de moda;
  • realizar o registro das vendas de pagamento digital, através da ferramenta Somabox, garantindo uma experiência de pagamento ágil e segura.
  • habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, com um espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e “escutatória”;
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais, essenciais para uma marca que conecta o físico e o digital;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:
    • saúde mental e bem estar;
    • assistência médica e odontológica, disponível mediante taxa de adesão e coparticipação de acordo com o uso;
    • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais;
    • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
      • parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo AZZAS.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

  • Requisitos obrigatórios:
    • Experiência prática com Flutter e Dart (profissional ou equivalente que comprove entregas reais).
    • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos.

    • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics e Remote Config.
    • Conhecimento de Git e rotina de pull request/code review (mesmo que com apoio).
    • Noções sólidas de qualidade : organização de código, tratamento de erros e atenção a performance.
    • Conhecimento básico de testes em Flutter (unit/widget) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Diferenciais:
    • Experiência com arquitetura no Flutter (Clean Architecture, MVVM, etc.).
    • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização.
    • Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
    • Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
    • Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
    • Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).

O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala.

Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;

  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

Vita Check‑up

  • Cadastrar informações de exames nos sistemas laboratoriais, de imagem e demais avaliações, garantindo fluxo ágil e seguro de atendimento.

  • Executar limpeza, desinfecção e esterilização de equipamentos e superfícies, conforme protocolos institucionais.

  • Cumprir estratégias e diretrizes da Diretoria, participando de reuniões e rituais de gestão quando solicitado.

Competências funcionais e técnicas

  • Conhecimento e experiência em coleta de sangue e demais exames laboratoriais.
  • Domínio dos processos de preparo de amostras biológicas (centrifugação, identificação, acondicionamento e envio).
  • Conhecimento de biossegurança e uso adequado de EPIs conforme NR‑32.
  • Noções de atendimento humanizado ao cliente em ambiente de saúde.

Clareza oral e escrita, capacidade de expressar suas ideias. Capacidade para ouvir e entender a necessidade dos clientes externos e internos das demais áreas do negócio.

  • Trabalho em equipe: trabalha cooperativamente, integrando pessoas e gerando uma ambiência de trabalho produtivo e colaborativo.
  • Adaptação à mudança: entendimento e capacidade de ajustar às prioridades, direcionamentos e conjuntura. Flexibilidade para mudança de acordo com o ambiente. Habilidade para reconhecer problemas e propor soluções.

Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Job Description

The position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Accessibility Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on accessibility and inclusivity.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the implementation of accessible infrastructure and services.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key responsibilities

Manage the delivery of key Sustainability & Human Rights Strategy initiatives to

  • Ensure an accessible FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ for disabled people and people with limited mobility, including:
  • Auditing of official FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ sites against FIFA’s accessibility requirements.
  • Ensuring improvements to fulfil those requirements are implemented.
  • Working with multiple functional areas and stakeholders to ensure accessible services and guidance are delivered for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Developing and delivering accessibility training and awareness raising for key functional areas and stakeholders.

Liaise with and/or support host cities and other organisations in Brazil or functional areas in their delivery of initiatives that

  • Facilitate accessibility for disabled people and people with limited mobility across physical infrastructure, public transport and services in Brazil.
  • Build local accessibility expertise to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ and foster the development of the sports and events industries in the region.
  • Empower people in the region through football programmes and the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ platform.

As a member of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Sustainability & Human Rights Team

  • Design and implement sustainable procurement practices that facilitate a welcoming and accessible tournament experience for participants, attendees and workforce.
  • Work closely with FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination staff based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your profile

Minimum requirements

  • A deep passion for sustainability and inclusivity, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices;
  • Deep familiarity with national and international accessibility standards for disabled people;
  • 5 years of work experience implementing accessibility programmes;
  • Experience of working in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry;
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes;
  • Demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication; and
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) planning software and online collaboration tools.

Candidates with experience in the following areas will have an advantage

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, equality, diversity and/or international relations;
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events;
  • Developing and delivering capacity‑building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders;
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications;
  • Working in sports and/or events;
  • International work experience;

Unique knowledge and skills

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe;

Requirements

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

Yinson is a leading global integrated offshore production company committed to fostering innovation and sustainability. title: Sales Analyst
description:
Overview


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.


Department and Location


Department: Partnerships & Media


Location: Brazil


The Position


The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.


She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.


The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.


Key Responsibilities



  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utiliseing a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.

  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.

  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.

  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.

  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.

  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team

  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.

  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.

  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.


Your Profile



  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.

  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.

  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)

  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship

  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market

  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.

  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.

  • Solutions orientated.

  • Solid time management and organizational skills.

  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.

  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.

  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.

  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.

  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.

  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area

  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage

  • Ability to travel often and when required.

  • Right to work in Brazil.

  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  6. Pós-Transmissão e Melhoria Contínua
    • Participar e/ou conduzir o debrief das transmissões, identificando acertos, falhas e oportunidades de melhoria.
    • Consolidar relatórios qualitativos e, quando aplicável, quantitativos (execução de entregas, problemas técnicos, feedback de audiência e repercussão digital).
    • Manter histórico de espelhos, roteiros, formatos e boas práticas, servindo como base para evolução dos produtos.

  • Define and order equipment and installation aids.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.

  • Arrange the testing and load‑out of Pre‑Commissioning equipment and installation aids.
  • Coordinate the execution of onshore & offshore Pre‑Commissioning work scopes.
  • Coordinate the demobilization of the Pre‑Commissioning equipment, marine spread and the off‑hire of subcontract equipment.
  • Work at site (onshore and offshore) as required by the project.
  • Prepare MOC's with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Compile and issue Site Memo’s and maintain system completion plan.
  • Compile and present return of experience and lesson learned documents.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Work with the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority to align on Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies.
  • Preparation of subcontractor scopes of works.
  • Manage Pre‑Commissioning subcontracts.
  • Daily Progress Reporting.

TENDERS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority in preparation of technical and commercial build‑ups following the Tendering work instruction.
  • Liaise with installation team during tender phase to ensure alignment on methodologies.
  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore tenders.
  • Engineering and planning for the timely execution of the work scope.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Reviewing of internal and external deliverables (specifications, standards, drawings, reports, procedures, risk assessments, scopes of work, subcontracts).
  • Prepare installation aids requirements.
  • Prepare subcontractor/vendor scopes of works and subsequent technical bid clarification.
  • Prepare pre‑commissioning method statements where required.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Attend site visits where applicable.
  • Technical bid clarification.
  • Provide input into Technical Bid Evaluation process.

Interfaces

The Senior Field Engineer will maintain strong interfaces with the various disciplines within the business line. The main interfaces for Pre‑Commissioning are:

  • Marine Operations Engineers
  • Engineering
  • SCM
  • QHSES
  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers
  • Marine Construction Manager
  • Tender Manager

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7 plus years of experience in the oil and gas industry working for major Contractors.
  • Experience managing a team of more than 2 Engineers.
  • The following experience is required:
    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
    • Rigid & flexible pipeline Pre‑Commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 8 projects.
    • Umbilical pre‑commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 4 projects.

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

A Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcios do Brasil. Acreditamos que democratizar o acesso ao crédito e impulsionar o desenvolvimento local são pilares para transformar a vida de famílias e fortalecer empresas.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.

title: Agente Educacional - Ensino - Ps-Graduao - IDOR RJ
description:
Descrição

Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D?Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos cujo objetivo é contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D?Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros. Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19. A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo
  • Desejável estar cursando ensino superior
  • Necessário conhecimento do Pacote Office

Atividades

  • Auxiliar os professores, instrutores e alunos nas atividades diárias
  • Receber, conferir e arquivar de forma física e digital documentos dos alunos da instituição
  • Atualizar e disponibilizar o quadro de horários e reservas de salas conforme disciplina e/ou curso
  • Realizar comunicados/informativos via telefone corporativo e/ou e-mail aos alunos, conforme orientação do gestor e/ou secretaria acadêmica
  • Confeccionar lista de presença dos alunos (provas, palestras e outros)
  • Realizar impressão de provas e disponibilizar aos professores no dia da aplicação ou quando solicitado, mantendo o sigilo e descrição referente às informações contidas nos arquivos
  • Organizar as salas de aula e laboratórios para as atividades diárias (ligar computadores, projetores, organizar as peças anatômicas, microscópios, insumos e equipamentos conforme a necessidade da disciplina/curso)
  • Solicitação e/ou reserva de salas em qualquer uma das unidades da instituição (CET, GL122 e DC30)
  • Conferir e atualizar dados cadastrais dos alunos da instituição
  • Zelar pelo bom funcionamento da instituição, relatando qualquer desconformidade acadêmica, operacional e de infraestrutura

Outras Informações

  • Botafogo - RJ

title: Geosupport Lead
description:
Overview

Welcome to PXGEO PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.

Role Official company title is Technical Lead - Geophysics. We are seeking an experienced Geophysicist to provide technical geophysical support across the Company's Sales & Marketing, Operations, and Engineering Development teams. This role plays a critical part in ensuring exceptional data quality throughout the full project lifecycle and will be responsible for data quality assurance from the initial receipt of tenders through to the delivery of final survey products to the Client. This position requires close collaboration with internal departments to ensure surveys meet technical, commercial, and client expectations.

Key responsibilities

  • Support for Sales
    • Provide alternative and/or additional survey designs or layouts to more efficiently meet clients\' geophysical objectives
    • Review incoming data acquisition tender requests and provide technical responses, including technical exceptions, survey area maps, shooting plan scenarios and source modelling
    • Complete project time and motion estimations where required
  • Support for Marketing
    • Contribute to the technical standing of the company through publications at industry conferences and in industry journals
    • Assist in the development of the company Geophysical Initiatives
    • Attend Client Meetings as required. As an expert, participate in meetings and contribute actively to development of client relations and participate in the promotion of the company\'s image of excellence
    • Compile and present geophysical and technical slides, and present Company geophysical initiatives
  • Support for Operations
    • Prepare project start-up documentation including preplots, shooting plans, operational maps, and parameter sheets as appropriate for the seismic method
    • Attend seismic project kick-off, start-up and close-out meetings if required to represent Geophysical Services and Technology group
    • Review end of job report for accuracy and quality
    • Problem dataset analysis with appropriate reporting
    • Assist in the design, writing and implementation of procedures, methods and technical content that facilitate good survey practices and the safe and effective operations of the Geophysical Department. Contribute to continual improvement and review of working practices and standards
    • Propose and implement best practices, new technologies and methodologies in QC processing offshore and geophysical support onshore
    • Ensure the geophysical quality of projects by assisting offshore QC Geophysicists to optimize sequences and parameters, contribute to the test and QC plan adapted to the project
    • Monitor Geophysical-related downtime and inform Management of potential means to reduce downtime
    • Review detailed analysis and provide recommendations on a weekly basis for ongoing projects. Recommendations should contain the following:
      • Acquired data quality Vessel performance
      • Coverage and Infill
    • Monitor the health of the deployed receiver spread
    • Provide support for and where necessary supervision of any production processing efforts for the project whether carried out onboard or by the third party onshore
  • Support for Engineering Development
    • Provide geophysical input into the research and development portfolio
    • In cooperation with Engineering Development, conduct technical studies and tests in order to validate new technologies and methodologies
    • Assist in planning, execution and analysis of acquisition technology tests
    • Develop and design source and receiver configurations
  • General
    • Keep abreast of changes in seismic data acquisition and processing technology
    • Administration of the Company seismic project documentation sharing portal and maintain all ITT & Project location history
    • Ensure department\'s assets are tracked and maintained according to Company procedures and best practices
    • Maintain the necessary software toolbox

Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Geophysics, Geoscience, Physics, or a related discipline
  • At least 5+ years of extensive experience in geophysical operations including seismic acquisition and QC, within onshore and offshore environments
  • Exposure to marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to all aspects of seismic surveys with a focus on geophysical method, and processing
  • In-depth knowledge of modern geophysical acquisition technologies and a solid understanding of emerging processing methods and their impact on acquisition design
  • Experience managing geophysical service providers and key technical suppliers
  • Solid understanding of EHSQ principles, compliance with management systems, and delivery of high-quality services
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to act as the primary technical interface for Operations

  • Experiência prévia em análises espaciais em projetos ambientais;
  • Conhecimentos introdutórios em Inteligência Artificial ou Machine Learning aplicados ao geoprocessamento;

title: CFD Engineer, Sustainability
description:
Overview

Job Description The Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) engineer belongs to the Global Sustainability Team focusing on ship energy and operational efficiency. As a Sustainability team engineer, you will contribute to the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. The CFD engineer is expected to interact with multiple parts of the organization, taking a lead role in driving the ABS Global Sustainability Advisory CFD services related to the hydrodynamic and aerodynamic performance of a vessel. The role requires involvement in international projects and supporting clients to improve the overall environmental performance of their vessels. Our Risk Management team in Brazil supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen.

What You Will Do

  • Execute CFD services to marine clients related to hull and propeller modification, hydrodynamic and aerodynamic energy efficiency technologies, trim optimization, and performance.
  • Contribute to studies that influence important engineering and operational decisions, while also helping shape the next generation of technical capability within the team.
  • Lead or support a variety of technical safety and risk studies, including: Fire and explosion modelling, Flame detector allocation, Exhaust and ventilation dispersion, Smoke and gas dispersion, Flare radiation analysis, Helideck turbulence studies and Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Be a focal point of contact for CFD-related services in ABS Global Sustainability: Interact with clients to identify/resolve problems in technical expertise.
  • Maintain and improve ABS numerical calculation tools concerning the CFD services.
  • Manage client projects related to CFD: Take the lead in projects related to vessel performance CFD services.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate team members to ensure client needs are met.
  • Develop numerical analysis-based services and products.
  • Contribute to the development of tools and services for ABS Global Sustainability.
  • Initiate and participate in joint development/industry projects with clients or OEMs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of national and international regulatory developments with environmental protection and update the Global Sustainability team accordingly. May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents.
  • Conduct seminars and workshops as requested.
  • Stay updated on emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Work as a team member or autonomously, as required.
  • Manage or support project execution, schedules, quality, and technical delivery.
  • Interact directly with clients to discuss technical issues, project progress, and solutions.
  • Support proposal development and technical presentations.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants, collaborating with teams in Brazil and other offices globally.

Requirements

What You Will Need

  • Degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical or Mechanical Engineering
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience
  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies
  • Fluent Portuguese and English
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment

Education and Experience Desired

  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field
  • Experience in QRA, vulnerability analysis, PHAST, and/or SAFETI
  • Knowledge of Human Factors, including: Human Reliability Analysis (HRA), Human Factors Engineering (HFE)
  • Familiarity with Petro-HRA
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulations and industry requirements, including Petrobras guidelines, ANP requirements, and applicable NRs
  • Experience across upstream, downstream, and midstream
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other programming/automation tools
  • Interest in digitalization and technical innovation
  • Spanish language skills

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Track record in applying CFD and data analysis software tools to deliver technical solutions to clients.
  • FLACS
  • KFX
  • Ansys Fluent
  • Ansys CFX
  • Hydrodynamics and naval architecture knowledge; aerodynamics is a plus
  • Working knowledge of Linux and CAD packages (e.g., Rhino 3D)
  • Knowledge of additional software: OpenFoam, StarCCM+, Paraview
  • Proficiency with scripting and coding languages for pre-processing, post-processing, and data analytics (Python or other)
  • Ability to solve complex problems and work independently or in a team
  • Ability to manage project requirements, budgets, schedules, and technical work
  • Experience with marine or offshore applications
  • Experience with programming and advanced MS Office use
  • Client presentation capability
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written)
  • Commitment to ethical business practices per corporate policies
  • Proficiency in English
  • Ability to develop working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, regulations, and safety policy

Reporting Relationships

Reporting directly to the operations manager.

About Us

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and related safety, quality, and environmental services. We support organizations facing evolving regulations and technologies, with a focus on safety, reliability, and efficiency. We are committed to supporting the global energy transition at sea and related innovations.

Equal Opportunity

The ABS Group of Companies is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status, veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics protected by law.

Notice

ABS will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement signed by Human Resources. Any resume or submission provided without a valid MSA will be considered ABS property.

Job Purpose

The Assistant Director – Military and Veterans Services (ADMVS) directs, plans, and organizes all veterans’ services initiatives. The ADMVS assists with and helps lead the department's vision, goals, and objectives for the department. The ADMVS reports to the Director of Student Services.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. The ADMVS performs the administrative and technical duties required to establish and maintain a program to assist Military connected individuals in obtaining educational, financial, social services and other benefits available through the Federal, State and local legislation. This position requires evening and weekend hours and accessibility as student needs arise.

Supervisory Accountability

Direct supervision of two Veterans Affairs Coordinators (Certifying School Officials). Supervision of one Veteran Resource Coordinator.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as point of contact for veteran's educational programs, policies, procedures and regulations
  • Serve as liaison between HU and the VA for eligibility for veteran students
  • Develop and expand the University's relationships with other U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and other services agencies
  • Provide accurate information to all interested parties regarding current educational benefits and programs which are provided by federal and state government and local agencies to support veterans
  • Counsel students and parents concerning eligibility and benefits available under various programs
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state government reporting requirements related to veterans’ educational benefits
  • Manage and monitor schedule changes, major changes, withdrawals, audits and inapplicable courses for appropriate changes in benefits
  • Implement control measures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of certification
  • Establish and maintain student VA files
  • Coordinate with the office of Admission and Recruiting, Records and Registration, Financial Aid, and Disabilities Services to improve the enrollment process for military connected students
  • Recommend, implement, and administer methods and procedures to enhance recruitment efforts
  • Develop a working knowledge of ASU academic programs that are of interest to veterans’ students
  • Evaluate U.S. Armed Forces transcripts for transfer credit and transfer equivalencies
  • Develop and maintain the department's website
  • Represent the University on committees and advisory groups that work to advance and enhance VA benefits, and state and regional organizations that assist veteran students with four-year college graduation
  • Actively promote programs that engage veterans and the campus community
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Senior Leaders within The Office of Student Services and Student Affairs

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Partner with the Howard University Bursar’s office for seamless and streamlined communication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with the financial aid office
  • Provide recommendations, tools and resources for faculty and staff to assist them in how to support military connected students
  • Develop, cultivate, and sustain collaborative and effective working relationships with key stakeholders outside the Division of Student Affairs

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, critical thinking, professional judgment, oral and written communication
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population
  • Self-directed; self-motivated individual who can work autonomously with minimal supervision while managing multiple situations
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, follow through, meet deadlines, and make professional decisions
  • Ability to work independently, collaboratively across multiple offices and in a team environment
  • Flexibility and accessibility particularly as it relates to responding to and attending to student needs
  • Demonstrated work ethic that illustrates integrity, ethics, sound professional judgment and an appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Competent and comfortable with technology and ability to utilize data to inform decisions
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with exceptionally good judgment and discretion
  • Experience supervising employees, including hiring and evaluation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in education, training, and experience
  • 3-5 years of experience with student support initiatives in higher education or a similar setting

Preferred Qualifications

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.
  • M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

About The Team

The Core Services Team builds and maintains the mission‑critical, high‑throughput, and fault‑tolerant foundational services that power the entire Uber platform. This includes global‑scale services for Safety, Identity, Payments, and other core business logic.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who operates with a broad scope, influencing the technical direction not just within your team but across multiple dependent platform and product teams. You will drive the design and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems, setting a high bar for engineering excellence and mentoring senior engineers across the organization.

  • Lead the design and architecture of large‑scale, resilient backend services and distributed systems for core platform components (e.g., ensuring high availability, sub‑millisecond latency, and strict data consistency).

  • Drive technical decision‑making and establish architectural standards and patterns for the wider Core Services organization, focusing on scalability, security, and multi‑region fault tolerance.
  • Implement critical, high‑performance backend features and microservices using modern languages (e.g., Go, Java) and infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Cassandra, Redis), ensuring they are secure and maintainable.

  • Act as a force multiplier by mentoring other backend engineers, elevating the technical capabilities and "systems thinking" of the entire organization.
  • Provide in‑depth, rigorous feedback in design and code reviews for critical systems, emphasizing distributed systems best practices, concurrency safety, and resource efficiency.
  • Contribute to the engineering culture by championing best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security‑first development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience in designing, building, and operating large‑scale, high‑availability distributed systems in a production environment.
  • Deep expertise in Backend Infrastructure: Strong mastery of microservices architecture, distributed databases, caching strategies, and asynchronous messaging systems.
  • Proven Leadership: Ability to lead multi‑quarter projects, break down ambiguous technical problems, and drive complex initiatives to successful completion across team boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • SRE Principles: Deep experience with site reliability engineering, including error budgeting, SLO/SLA definition, and building self‑healing systems.
  • Influence: A track record of influencing backend engineering strategy and architecture across different organizational boundaries and functional areas.
