  • Apoiar a gestão do Canal de Integridade.
  • Apoiar e conduzir treinamentos de compliance para áreas da Companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica, graduação em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas; desejável pós‑graduação em Compliance, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos.

  • Conhecimentos específicos sólidos em Due diligence de Integridade, na Lei nº 12.846/2013 e no Decreto nº 11.129/2022, com familiaridade com legislações internacionais anticorrupção e antissuborno, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido), bem como com regimes de sanções internacionais (ex.: OFAC, União Europeia) e diretrizes e referências nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis, incluindo o Programa de Integridade da CGU e as diretrizes da OCDE; experiência em controles internos, matriz de riscos e indicadores (KRIs e KPIs), incluindo vivência em avaliações de maturidade de programas de integridade (ex.: Pró‑Ética e Ethos).
  • Conhecimento em proteção de dados e privacidade (LGPD), e desejável familiaridade com a regulação aplicável ao setor de óleo e gás (ANP).
  • Ferramentas e sistemas: conhecimento em ferramentas de produtividade, análise de dados e automação, incluindo uso de inteligência artificial aplicada ao trabalho, automação de tarefas (ex.: Power Automate) e elaboração de dashboards (ex.: Power BI), bem como familiaridade com Python (desejável) e com ferramentas de due diligence de integridade.

A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;

  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;

Habilidades e Conhecimentos

  • Legislação e Normas: NRs (especialmente NR 1 – GRO/PGR, NR 6, NR 10 (Básico e SEP), NR 12, NR 18, NR 33, NR 35), ABNT NBR aplicáveis ao setor elétrico, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, boas práticas de OHS/EHS.

  • Resposta a Emergências: linhas energizadas, arco elétrico, quedas de altura, espaços confinados, resgate técnico, incidentes ambientais correlatos.
  • Ferramentas: Pacote Office (Excel avançado, PowerPoint, Word), Power BI (desejável domínio de dashboards), softwares de EHS (Enablon, Intelex, SOGI, Quirius ou similares), ferramentas de gestão de manutenção (CMMS/ERP) e controle de documentos (EDMS).

  • Atuações anteriores com análises de risco, liberação de atividades críticas, avaliação de projetos (HSE by design) e gestão de contratadas em empreendimentos de Transmissão (LT/SE) e Geração Hidrelétrica (UHE).
  • Suporte e interface com as áreas de Projetos, Construção, O&M, Jurídico, Suprimentos e Meio Ambiente, garantindo que os requisitos de SST sejam incorporados desde a engenharia até a operação.

  • Consolidar e reportar indicadores e planos executivos de SST à alta liderança, apoiando tomada de decisão baseada em risco e priorização de investimentos.

description:

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with a great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions.

Job Function

Integrity Engineer

Summary

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

Key Competencies

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) .

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

title: Senior Manager Human Resources Latam
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, RJ, BR

Work Arrangement: Hybrid

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Human Resources LATAM serves as a strategic and tactical business partner to the LATAM team, driving the execution of HR strategies for the region. Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.
    • Ensure HR strategies are effectively aligned with business priorities, fostering an adaptable and high-performing workforce.
    • Provide expert consultation to managers and senior leaders on HR-related matters.
    • Collaborate across departments to ensure a seamless employee experience and a strong people strategy.
  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.
  • Lead efforts to enhance talent mobility and strengthen leadership capabilities within the organization.
  • Manage talent engagement processes, including recruitment, compensation, promotions, training, and performance management, in partnership with the local HR team.
  • Support global mobility for key employees, collaborating with global mobility teams and HR peers.
  • Employee Engagement and culture
    • Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive work environment that aligns with Dover values and DFS’ company culture.
    • Support initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workplace satisfaction, and long-term retention.
  • Consult with business leaders to drive organizational design, change management, and leadership development strategies.
  • Diagnose workforce gaps and design solutions for regional and local implementation.
  • Oversee succession planning processes, fostering leadership development and career progression for key talent.
  • HR Operations, compliance & leadership
    • Manage, guide, and mentor HR team members based in Rio de Janeiro.
    • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global HR requirements.
    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources management or business administration.
  • Experience in partnering with senior leadership teams.
  • Experience in multiple locations.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English language skills, both verbal and written, Spanish is a preference.
  • Exceptional critical thinking skills: ability to decompose complex problems, prioritize issues, and implement sensible solutions.
  • Track record of creating strong partnerships and influencing at all levels of the organization.
  • Superior interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase productivity and continuously improve methods, approaches.
  • Experience in organizational development and change management.
  • Proven ability to work in a fluid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality.

Dover Fueling Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other factors prohibited by law.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

This URL is for benefits and wellness: Function

The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain scheduling and tracking systems for long-acting injectable HIV medications.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff and specialty pharmacies to ensure timely medication procurement and dosing.
  • Monitor injection schedules and proactively address potential delays or barriers to care.
  • Assist with patient reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up outreach to reduce missed visits.
  • Perform patient check-in and check-out procedures.
  • Verify insurance eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient interactions and care coordination activities in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
  • Support reporting initiatives related to patient engagement and viral suppression outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, nurses, case managers, and pharmacy partners.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred).
  • Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization. Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package: - Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.
- Transportation vouchers.
- Meals vouchers.
- Health and Dental insurance.
- Birthday day off.
- Gympass / Totalpass. If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

Implementar e aplicar procedimentos e padrões de controle de documentos, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações do setor e as políticas organizacionais. Coordenar a distribuição e a recuperação de documentos, garantindo que os documentos certos estejam disponíveis para as pessoas certas no momento certo. Garantir a segurança e a confidencialidade dos documentos, implementando controles de acesso e sistemas de monitoramento para proteger informações sensíveis. Manter arquivos de documentos organizados e eficientes, tanto digitais quanto físicos, garantindo que todos os documentos sejam devidamente etiquetados, indexados e armazenados para fácil recuperação. Monitorar os fluxos de trabalho de documentos, acompanhando o status de envios, revisões e aprovações de documentos para garantir a conclusão em tempo hábil. Auxiliar na digitalização de documentos físicos, convertendo registros em papel em formatos digitais e integrando-os a sistemas eletrônicos de gerenciamento de documentos (EDMS). Fornecer treinamento e suporte à equipe sobre procedimentos de controle de documentos e o uso de sistemas de gerenciamento de documentos, garantindo práticas consistentes em toda a organização. Colaborar com as equipes de projeto e fornecedores externos para gerenciar o fluxo de documentação, garantindo que todos os documentos estejam corretos, atualizados e devidamente arquivados. Relatar as atividades de controle de documentos à gerência, fornecendo atualizações sobre o status do processamento de documentos e quaisquer problemas que possam surgir. Requisitos: Graduação completa em gestão da informação, gestão de arquivos, biblioteconomia ou áreas correlatas. Certificações como Certified Records Manager (CRM), Certified Information Professional (CIP) ou Electronic Records Management (ERM) são desejáveis. Experiência no gerenciamento de todo o ciclo de vida do documento, incluindo criação, revisão, aprovação, distribuição e arquivamento, garantindo que todos os documentos sejam devidamente controlados e acessíveis. Proficiência no uso de ferramentas e softwares de controle de documentos, como SharePoint, Aconex ou Documentum, para gerenciar fluxos de trabalho de documentos, controle de versões e permissões de acesso. Proficiência em processos de controle de documentos, gestão de arquivos e no uso de sistemas de gestão documental (DMS). Experiência com implementação e manutenção de sistemas de controle de documentos para garantir o gerenciamento preciso e eficiente de documentos e registros de projetos. Inglês Avançado

description:

Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:- Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;

- Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
- Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
- Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
- Ajudar os times na construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
- Identificar pontos demelhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
- Apoiar a estruturaçãoe reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
- Remover impedimentos egarantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:- Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
- Conhecimento em OKRs epráticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
- Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
- Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;

- Habilidade para atuarcom métricas de performance e cultura de times.Requisitos desejáveis:- Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
- Experiência como AgileCoach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
- Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
- Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
- Conhecimento em cultura DevOps e Design Thinking.- Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAISAntes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.Dito isso, oferecemos:● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Requisitos O candidato ideal combina profunda expertise técnica em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (incluindo GenAI) com fortes habilidades de liderança e comunicação. Experiência prática significativa na implantação de sistemas em produção em Azure ou GCP com foco em escalabilidade e confiabilidade. Experiência com integração, transformação, armazenamento e análise de dados, incluindo workflows de vídeo (ingestão, processamento, transformação e análise). Experiência comprovada na implementação de pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e automação de infraestrutura em produtos reais. The product is designed for non-expert users in lab environments and prioritizes speed, clarity, and reproducibility over visual complexity. This engagement has two primary goals: defining UX for new feature development and supporting the adoption of updated iOS design guidelines. Scope of Work: New Feature Wireframes You will define wireframes and UX flows for new features prior to development, ensuring alignment between product and engineering teams. These include: A new navigation hub for multiple software modules, including clear handling of licensed vs. unlicensed states A time-series data acquisition feature with configuration, live feedback, and playback for multi-dimensional datasets Two new image analysis modules with consistent flows for launch, controls, results visualization, and save/discard actions Enhancements to an existing analysis module to support additional configurations A data export feature supporting multiple formats and destinations with error handling iOS Design System Adoption Review existing screens against updated iOS Human Interface Guidelines Identify required updates for custom controls such as overlays, sliders, selectors, and timelines Propose adaptations to align with new system design patterns while maintaining a professional, lab-focused interface Ensure new designs are aligned with updated platform standards from the start Expected Deliverables: Annotated low- to mid-fidelity wireframes for all new feature flows, approved by the product Design assessment and recommendations for updated iOS design system adoption Final design files delivered in a format usable by the iOS development team Required Skills: 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX designer with robust experience designing for iPad applications. Apple Platform Mastery: Deep familiarity with Apple HIG specifically for iPad, including expert use of split views, sidebars, popovers, and touch-target optimization. iOS 26 Familiarity: Working knowledge of the Liquid Glass design system, including navigation bars, sheets, and modal presentations under the new paradigm. Wireframing & Tools: Senior-level experience in producing annotated, implementation-ready wireframes using tools such as Figma or Sketch. Scientific UI Experience: Experience designing interfaces where data precision and reproducibility are prioritized;
prior work with medical, clinical, or industrial apps is a strong plus. Team Fit & Work Style: Ability to work from written requirements without dedicated UX research support Self-directed and comfortable working in small teams Comfortable working within established design systems rather than creating new visual languages Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken Experience working in distributed remote teams and async environments Nice to Have: Experience in laboratory, life sciences, or medical software Experience working with design systems within the Apple ecosystem Engagement: Short-term contract, 5–6 weeks at a part-time capacity (80 hours per month) with PST work hours overlap. description:

Manter o currículo atualizado com as normas da Receita Federal, decisões dos tribunais (STJ/STF) e novas estratégias de planejamento patrimonial. Atuar como instância final de solução de problemas acadêmicos, mediar a relação entre alunos e professores, e representar o curso externamente. Monitorar a taxa de sucesso e evasão dos alunos, buscando a melhoria contínua da qualidade do ensino, conforme padrões de educação.

Perfil Desejado:

Formação: Especialização, Mestrado ou Doutorado na área Jurídica, preferencialmente Direito Tributário ou Societário. Experiência com coordenação. description:

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state‑of‑the‑art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (we will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter‑service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes
You will be responsible for
  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization‑wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on‑call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs
We Are Looking For a Person Who Has
  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large‑scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object‑oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade‑offs clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills

A Movida é uma empresa de soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana e modelo de negócios com forte direcionamento para desenvolvimento socioambiental. Desde 2006 no mercado, conta hoje com a frota mais nova do Brasil e dispõe de lojas nas principais cidades e aeroportos do país. A companhia é reconhecida como uma locadora moderna, alinhada às últimas tendências tecnológicas e que investe em diversificação e renovação de frota, treinamento de funcionários e serviços exclusivos.

Norteada pela devoção em servir, foi pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal e de longo prazo para pessoa física, opções para pré-pagamento e diárias de 27 horas. Focada em tecnologia, também saiu na frente do setor ao oferecer soluções como web check-in, wi‑fi no carro, chatbot nas redes sociais e tecnologia de pagamento contactless em todos os veículos.

Empresa da SIMPAR, hoje faz parte da Movida Participações, criada em 2015 para administrar as operações de Aluguel de Carros, Venda de Seminovos e de Gestão de Terceirização de Frotas de veículos leves.

Com mais de 6000 colaboradores apaixonados, a Movida se diferencia pelo seu "jeitão" inovador e descomplicado. Carrega em seu DNA o foco no cliente e a sua GENTE como prioridade!

Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pelaMOVIDA são afirmativos,inclusivos e não discriminatórios.

Responsabilidades e Qualificações
  • Gerenciar as atividades das equipes de trabalho da loja e todo pessoal de apoio;
  • Elaborar e validar escalas de horários, controle de ponto, anotações de justificativas de atrasos e faltas;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores de cada colaborador através de avaliações e feedbacks, buscando o desenvolvimento de acordo com a necessidade;
  • Realizar abertura e fechamento de caixa;
  • Acompanhar e gerenciar a qualidade de atendimento na loja, baseado nos indicadores da empresa;
  • Orientar a equipe quanto às diretrizes gerenciais e estratégicas da corporação, sempre criando sinergia e estimulando o trabalho em equipe;
  • Organizar e conservar o ambiente de trabalho, coordenando o uso de materiais, insumos, recursos e serviços;
  • Atender aos clientes em demandas normais e específicas, incluindo rotinas de recepção;
  • Auxiliar nos processos seletivos encaminhados pelo time de R&S.
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de pessoas;
  • Desejável vivência sólida no varejo automotivo;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala 6X1;
  • Salário fixo + comissão.

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

Benefícios
  • LIGADO EM VOCÊ: Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto.
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas + Kit nascimento para recém‑mamães e recém‑papais.
  • Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na MOVIDA , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar para os filhos da nossa gente.
  • Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem‑estar.
  • Pela Universidade MOVIDA , a nossa gente aprende e potencializa seu desenvolvimento profissional, tornando cada um(a) protagonista de sua carreira.
  • Reconhecemos e valorizamos a nossa gente veterana que completa anos de casa. Quem possui mais de 15 anos , ainda tem um evento mega especial.
  • Cantinho da Mamãe: O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado as mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno. No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.
  • Totalpass: Ace sso a uma ampla rede de academias e serviços de saúde mental e nutrição, promovendo hábitos saudáveis e bem‑estar.
  • Pet Love: Para cuidar também do seu filho de quatro patas, incluímos um benefício especial para mais esse membro da sua família.

Se identificou com essa vaga? Conheça as nossas vagas, inscreva‑se e vamos juntos participar dessa Empresa que cresce todos os dias.

A Movida (MOVI3) é uma empresa de aluguel de carros que oferece soluções inovadoras em mobilidade urbana para todo tipo de necessidade. Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi‑Fi no carro, pré‑pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. Antenada aos novos tempos, investe em sustentabilidade, sendo a primeira locadora de veículos no mundo, listada em bolsa, a receber a Certificação de Empresa B, fazendo parte de um seleto grupo de companhias que têm como modelo de negócios o desenvolvimento socioambiental. No Brasil, foi a primeira a ter um programa como o Carbon Free, que neutraliza as emissões de CO₂ das locações dos seus clientes.

Desde 2006 no mercado, a Movida foi adquirida em 2013 pela JSL, abriu capital em fevereiro de 2017 e hoje é uma das empresas da SIMPAR S.A. Com perfil inovador aliado a forte governança corporativa, atua tanto no varejo, com aluguel de carros, como no mercado corporativo, com a terceirização de frotas para empresas, além da venda de seminovos. Após diversos investimentos nos últimos quatro anos, conta com uma frota de mais de 268 mil veículos, 259 lojas de aluguel de carros e 89 pontos de venda de seminovos. title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level
Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering
  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
